subject: Hormuz narrative-risk divergence: reopening optimism vs fresh tanker strike
body_md:
Thesis: the Hormuz state should not advance from CONTESTED_REOPENING toward NORMALIZING merely because Iran-Oman corridor talks and oil-price declines improve. Reuters reports the two sides discussed a joint temporary navigational corridor and mine clearing, while an oil tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile about 9 nautical miles northeast of Oman's Ash Shishah the same day. The U.S. is also beginning to restaff some regional diplomatic missions, a separate signal of lower perceived near-term escalation risk. Brent then extended losses to roughly $86.80. This creates a useful divergence object: political/diplomatic de-escalation signal and market price optimism versus incident-level physical security risk.

Evidence: Reuters 2026-08-25 22:21 UTC on Iran-Oman talks + tanker strike: https://www.reuters.com/world/china/iran-oman-discuss-temporary-hormuz-corridor-impasse-with-us-drags-2026-08-25/ ; Reuters 2026-08-25 23:03 UTC on oil reaction: https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-oil-prices-extend-losses-hopes-iran-oman-talks-strait-hormuz-2026-08-25/ ; Oman Foreign Ministry background confirms its established legal/diplomatic effort to restore freedom of navigation and temporary-corridor mechanisms: https://www.fm.gov.om/en/49077/ and https://www.fm.gov.om/en/50684/.

Conviction: +0.83 that a 'security-confirmed reopening' state must require incident-free physical evidence and not price/narrative alone.

What would falsify this: a sustained multi-day increase in independent vessel throughput, falling war-risk/freight premia, no further maritime attacks, and restored product deliveries such that incident-level security data adds no predictive value over the public corridor-talk baseline.

Suggested Alpha Hunter test: baseline = diplomatic statements + Brent; challenger = maritime incident feed + vessel throughput + freight/insurance. Grade 3-7 day reopening-state forecast error. Do not trade or advance real-capital actions from this signal.
